summary.storyTitle: Story 5: Inspection, Reporting, Snapshot, And Export
summary.implementedScope: Added SQLite-aware `lhx` readiness/reporting support with optional-driver-safe loading and bundled-rollout portability, then introduced SQLite snapshot/export service APIs plus legacy-labeled debug export coverage.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

evidence: Focused repro command now exits 0 and human output renders unknown maintenance statuses instead of throwing.
Projection readiness now maps missing, blocked, and write_failed to blocked, reload_failed/degraded/issues to degraded, and only ready generated files with records to ready.

changedFiles.reason: Added backing-aware thread loading, mixed file/SQLite resolution, bundled generated-rollout fallback, and testable optional SQLite driver handling.
Added readiness inspection, widened band source-id parsing, and composed projection/token/maintenance readiness summaries.
Added the new `lhx inspect readiness` command entrypoint.
Routed readiness commands and validated the new `--backing` option.
Documented readiness inspection and backing selection in CLI help.
Extended public inspection contracts with backing selection and readiness result types.
Exported readiness inspector and formatter APIs.
Added SQLite inspection coverage for summary/tokens/bands/report/readiness and optional-driver fallback behavior.
Extended CLI routing coverage to include readiness commands and aliases.
Added SQLite snapshot creation, restore, and legacy debug export services with manifest labeling and generated-rollout bundling.
Added snapshot portability, restore, and missing-rollout warning coverage for SQLite bundles.
Added coverage for explicit legacy debug export ownership labeling and inspectability.
Added compatibility coverage proving fixture/export workflows do not create split-brain live JSON source files.
